carried_by: the fact payload of a realm's state, carried inside AESV and ACK1 envelopes; written by state_save and read by state_load
unit: words (whole numbers; a host stores each as it stores an int)
header: magic 1179866161 ("FST1"), version 1, the schema's id and revision, the schema's SHA-256 as eight 32-bit words, the epoch it was saved under (the reader's fence), the tick, the day, the phase, the sequence, and the count of saved facts
body: sixteen words a saved fact, its id first and then its value; then the SHA-256 of every word before, as eight 32-bit words
rules: the schema's id, revision and digest are the reader's source schema's
the epoch is the reader's fence
the count is the schema's saved facts and the payload is exactly 26 words and sixteen a fact
the last eight words are the digest of the rest

fixture.source: a schema of one saved fact (id 11, "world.flag", a flag that starts true), epoch 3, tick 17, day 19, phase 23, sequence 29 (format-profile.coax fp_fst1, written by state_save)

refused.what: two saved facts stated, one held
a digest that isn't the words'
